essence: The verse enumerates members of the group known as the twelve suns.
The deities are to be honored through obeisances, incense, and ghee oblations.
The gandharvas and apsarases, including Citrasena and Agnisenaka, are to be worshipped.
The list continues with Sūryavarcā, Yugaputra, Suśira, and the pair Amara and Nandin.
The enumeration continues with Urvīśa, Kali, Parvata, and Nārada.
